parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to obtain the instance ID.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the query. The end time must be later than the start time, and the interval between the start time and end time must be less than 31 days. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ (UTC).

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number. Valid values: any integer greater than 0 that does not exceed the maximum value of Integer.

Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: **30** to **100**. Default value: **30**.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the query. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ (UTC).
